entities.name: Abd ar-Rahman II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd ar-Rahman II was the fourth Umayyad Emir of Córdoba in al-Andalus from 822 until his death in 852. A vigorous and effective frontier warrior, he was also well known as a patron of the arts.
